questions: Q1: Were all 8 files created/modified as specified in the implementation plan?
Q2: Does the CI parser script correctly discover all CLI surface tokens and enforce coverage?
Q3: Does the negative test correctly catch missing tokens?
Q4: Do hlx skill show and hlx skill install work correctly with the new content?

answers.answer: Yes. All 8 files are present with correct content: SKILL.md (83 lines, 10-section progressive-disclosure), commands.md (387 lines, full CLI surface), current-state.md (13 lines, dated PR #86 note), recovery.md (114 lines, GitHub-release-asset flow), ticket-prompting.md (144 lines, 7 sections), check-coverage.mjs (262 lines, CI parser), skill-sync.yml (22 lines, CI workflow), pull_request_template.md (7 lines, PR template).
evidence: wc -l confirms all 8 files exist with expected line counts (total 1032 lines)
All files verified on disk with correct content via grep and read operations

answers.answer: Yes. The parser script recursively discovers 75 tokens (29 subcommands, 39 flags, 7 enums) from --help output and exits 0 when all are covered in SKILL.md + commands.md. It correctly handles pipe-separated subcommand alternatives (org current|list|switch), angle-bracket enum groups (<AUTO|BUILD|...>), and prose-format rating values (thumbs-up, thumbs-down, love).
evidence: Parser output: 'Found 75 tokens (29 subcommands, 39 flags, 7 enums)' and 'All 75 CLI surface tokens are covered in skill docs.' with exit code 0
Parser uses HLX_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=1 to suppress network calls; captures both stdout and stderr from help invocations

answers.answer: Yes. Removing all occurrences of '--search' from commands.md causes the parser to exit 1 with stderr listing '[flag] --search' as a missing token. The file was restored after the test.
evidence: Negative test output: 'Missing CLI surface tokens (1): [flag] --search' with exit code 1
commands.md restored from backup after test

No code changes to install.ts were needed.
evidence: skill show output starts with 'name: hlx-cli' and the new trigger-heavy description
skill install directory listing shows SKILL.md + references/ with all 4 files

statement: Implementation complete (retry pass). All 8 files verified present with correct content. Prior verification found 5 files missing/old; all are now present and pass all 13 CHK checks. The CI parser discovers 75 CLI surface tokens and confirms full coverage. Build, typecheck, 63 tests, positive/negative parser tests, skill show, and skill install all pass.
